remarks: Bright 2BR/2BA Greenwich condo in a well-maintained complex, freshly painted with brand-new carpet -- ready for move-in. The standout feature: two assigned parking spaces, one just steps from the rear entrance. Most units require hauling groceries up a flight of stairs -- not this one. Pull in, walk a few feet, you're home. Step outside to your own private patio for morning coffee or evening downtime. About a mile to the Port Chester Metro-North station for an easy NYC commute, walking distance to Byram Park (beach, playgrounds, kayaking, summer concerts), and minutes to the shops and restaurants of Byram village. Quick access to I-95 and the Merritt. Greenwich address, quiet complex, and the kind of everyday convenience you'll appreciate from day one. (SHOWING AVAILABILITY: M-F 5pm-7pm, Sat/Sun 1pm-4pm)
